name: Corporate
oneLiner: Structured grids and enterprise patterns that read as reliable before the copy says anything.

notes: Blue on white reads as a link, so never colour body copy with the accent.
Status must not rely on colour alone: keep the text label next to every pill.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500

secondary.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem

default.base: padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)
font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--uiux-color-text)

header.base: height: 40px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500

do: Keep the blue for primary actions and links; it is the trust signal, not decoration.
Snap everything to an 8px grid and keep tables at 44px rows.
Use tabular figures for every money or metric value.
dont: Do not introduce playful or warm accents into a business surface.
Do not use serif faces or display tracking.
Do not stack more than one level of card inside another.
antiPatterns: A gradient hero on a product admin page.
Colour-coded status pills with no text label.
